articles.summary: SHANGHAI, June 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ATRenew Inc. (" ATRenew " or the "Company") (NYSE: RERE), a pioneer in technology-driven recycling and trade-in solutions for consumer products in China, today released its 2025 Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report.
articles.title: ATRenew Releases 2025 ESG Report: Advancing Sustainable Growth by Leading the Circular Economy
